company_name: Chiba Institute of Technology, Nanoelectronics Laboratory (Suga Laboratory)
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The laboratory contributes to the semiconductor industry by developing advanced testing equipment and nanotechnology tools.
summary: The Chiba Institute of Technology's Nanoelectronics Laboratory (Suga Laboratory) focuses on developing advanced equipment and nanotechnology tools for the semiconductor industry. Their work includes creating environmental stress systems and Highly Accelerated Stress Testing (HAST) systems to evaluate semiconductor device reliability under various conditions.
capabilities: Environmental stress systems for temperature, humidity, and pressure testing

regional_presence.Japan: The laboratory operates within the Chiba Institute of Technology, contributing to research and development in Japan.
